touches.text: Machine: tools plus the glue that holds them together. Has an owner. Anything that calls another component, uses other tools, or owns state it must gate is a machine. Lives inside its device (cairn/devices/<device>/machines/<machine>/), or in cairn/machines/ when several devices hold one (16).
Owns the inspectors and gates (9.4): everything in the code pipeline that checks. The exception is diagnostic_inspector, which is base's (17.1).
plan_inspector: reads charters' own admissions of what they don't yet do, so nothing reads as done while it says otherwise.
